description: This file defines the 'Attributable' interface in the OpenMRS project, which specifies methods for objects that can be associated with person attributes, including serialization, deserialization, and retrieval of possible values.

classes.name: Attributable
classes.description: A Java interface indicating that a class implementing it can be used as a value for a PersonAttribute in OpenMRS, providing methods for serialization, deserialization, and listing possible values.

methods.name: hydrate
methods.description: Deserialize a string into a full object of type E.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Convert the current object into a string identifier.

methods.name: getPossibleValues
methods.description: Retrieve all possible values of this object, though deprecated.

methods.name: findPossibleValues
methods.description: Find possible values based on a search string, also deprecated.

methods.name: getDisplayString
methods.description: Get a descriptive string for display purposes.
